name: Contract Automation
description: An automated bid desk that never sleeps. Switches on the Contracts Clerk: it accepts fitting offers for you and keeps 6% of what those jobs earn.

flavor.quote: The division of labour can be applied with equal success to mental as to mechanical operations
flavor.author: Charles Babbage
flavor.source: On the Economy of Machinery and Manufactures, 1832

name: Research Library Access
description: Licensed journal access for the research team. Research points earned +10%.

flavor.quote: Self-education is, I firmly believe, the only kind of education there is.
flavor.author: Isaac Asimov

name: Preferred Vendor Status
description: Your invoices are paid ahead of the queue. Contract payouts +5%.

flavor.quote: How not to do it was the great study and object of all public departments and professional politicians all round the Circumlocution Office.
flavor.author: Charles Dickens

name: Cost Accounting Reform
description: Costs are now allocated per rack. Facility upkeep -8%.

flavor.quote: When you can measure what you are speaking about, and express it in numbers, you know something about it
flavor.author: Lord Kelvin
flavor.source: Electrical Units of Measurement, lecture of 3 May 1883

name: Authority Liaison Desk
description: A named contact at the Compute Authority. Contract payouts +4%.

flavor.quote: The Circumlocution Office was (as everybody knows without being told) the most important Department under Government.
flavor.author: Charles Dickens

name: Group Procurement
description: Bulk purchasing across every vendor. Facility upkeep -7%.

flavor.quote: The bearing of a child takes nine months, no matter how many women are assigned.
flavor.author: Fred Brooks

name: Authority Framework Agreement
description: A multi-year agreement signed at director level. The pen is on a chain. Contract payouts +4%. Research points earned +15%.

flavor.quote: In this world nothing can be said to be certain, except death and taxes.
flavor.author: Benjamin Franklin
flavor.source: Letter to Jean-Baptiste Le Roy, 13 November 1789

name: Batch Scheduler Upgrade
description: Better packing for the job queue. Contract payouts +3%.

flavor.quote: We may say most aptly that the Analytical Engine weaves algebraical patterns just as the Jacquard-loom weaves flowers and leaves.
flavor.author: Ada Lovelace

name: Rear-Door Cabinet Design
description: A reference design for a heat exchanger on the cabinet door. Unlocks the AC-3 Rear-Door Rack: 42 PFLOPS at 55 kW.

flavor.quote: Premature optimization is the root of all evil (or at least most of it) in programming.
flavor.author: Donald Knuth
flavor.source: Computer Programming as an Art, CACM, 1974

name: Tape Library Engineering
description: Robotic retrieval for bulk datasets. Unlocks the Tape Library TL-8000: 8,000 TB at 30 kW.

flavor.quote: Science is what we understand well enough to explain to a computer. Art is everything else we do.
flavor.author: Donald Knuth

name: Hot-Aisle Containment
description: Ducted exhaust and sealed aisle ends. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%. The AC-4 Hot-Aisle Rack it once unlocked is no longer built.

flavor.quote: Shuffling is the only thing which Nature cannot undo.
flavor.author: Arthur Eddington
flavor.source: The Nature of the Physical World, 1928

name: Cold-Plate Generation 3
description: Machined cold plates rated for 160 kW per cabinet. Unlocks the LC-3 Cold-Plate Rack: 230 PFLOPS at 160 kW.

flavor.quote: Nothing is too wonderful to be true, if it be consistent with the laws of nature
flavor.author: Michael Faraday

name: Specialist Cards Programme
description: Fixed-function cards from a contract foundry, and event-driven silicon that idles when there is nothing to say. Unlocks the IA-1 Inference Accelerator (95 PFLOPS at 36 kW) and the NM-1 Neuromorphic Rack (50 PFLOPS at 12 kW).

flavor.quote: The Analytical Engine has no pretensions whatever to originate any thing.
flavor.author: Ada Lovelace
flavor.source: Notes by the Translator, Scientific Memoirs, 1843

name: Blade Manifold Architecture
description: Rack-scale blades that blind-mate to the coolant manifold. Unlocks the LC-4 Blade Rack: 420 PFLOPS at 240 kW.

flavor.quote: The art of programming is the art of organizing complexity
flavor.author: Edsger W. Dijkstra

name: Airflow Standardisation
description: One fan model, one mounting spec, fewer surprises. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%.

flavor.quote: Humans are allergic to change.
flavor.author: Grace Hopper

name: Rear-Door Exchanger Licence
description: A chilled-water coil on a hinge, under licence. Unlocks the Row Air Handler AH-320.

flavor.quote: There cannot be a greater mistake than that of looking superciliously upon the practical applications of science.
flavor.author: Lord Kelvin
flavor.source: Electrical Units of Measurement, lecture of 3 May 1883

name: Chilled-Water Loop Design
description: Pump curves and loop balancing, done properly. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%. Unlocks the LC-2 Liquid-Cooled Rack, the Coolant Distribution Unit and the Chiller CH-600; without it a tower stays on air.

flavor.quote: I counted everything.
flavor.author: Katherine Johnson
flavor.source: Interview remarks, as collected by Wikiquote

name: High-Capacity Air Handling
description: A fan wall sized for a whole hall. Unlocks the High-Capacity Air Handler AH-700.

flavor.quote: Just moving the little trim tab builds a low pressure that pulls the rudder around.
flavor.author: Buckminster Fuller

name: Cooling Tower Hydraulics
description: A tower, a basin and a water-use permit. Unlocks the Cooling-Tower Chiller CH-2400. Unlocks the Row Coolant Distribution Unit.

flavor.quote: Basic research is what I am doing when I don't know what I am doing.
flavor.author: Wernher von Braun

name: Dielectric Fluid Handbook
description: Handling and disposal procedures for immersion fluid. Unlocks the IM-1 Immersion Tank: 300 PFLOPS at 180 kW.

flavor.quote: Work. Finish. Publish.
flavor.author: Michael Faraday
flavor.source: Advice to William Crookes, in Gladstone, Michael Faraday, 1874

name: Adiabatic Free Cooling
description: Evaporate the loop in open air and let the sky take the heat. CRAH, chiller and CDU capacity +5%. Unlocks the Adiabatic Chiller CH-5000.

flavor.quote: In math, you're either right or you're wrong.
flavor.author: Katherine Johnson
flavor.source: Interview remarks, as collected by Wikiquote

name: Two-Phase Immersion
description: Boiling fluid and a condenser coil. Not a spectator sport. Rack failure rate -5%. Unlocks the IM-2 Two-Phase Immersion Tank: 560 PFLOPS at 300 kW.

flavor.quote: The energy of the universe is constant. The entropy of the universe tends to a maximum.
flavor.author: Rudolf Clausius

name: Surge Protection Standard
description: Fuses on every circuit, in writing. Rack failure rate -5%.

flavor.quote: If you believe too much you'll never notice the flaws; if you doubt too much you won't get started.
flavor.author: Richard Hamming

name: Off-Peak Tariff Agreement
description: A negotiated night rate with the utility. Grid energy price -5%.

flavor.quote: Simplicity is a great virtue but it requires hard work to achieve it and education to appreciate it.
flavor.author: Edsger W. Dijkstra

name: Substation Licence
description: Permission to connect a dedicated 11 kV feeder. Unlocks the Grid Intake 3.5 MW.

flavor.quote: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
flavor.author: Linus Torvalds

name: Flywheel Licence
description: Rotor storage that bridges a minute of load in a second. Unlocks the Flywheel UPS 60 kWh.

flavor.quote: Genius is one per cent inspiration, ninety-nine per cent perspiration
flavor.author: Thomas Edison

name: Gas Turbine Concession
description: A pipeline tap and a turbine to go with it. Grid energy price -3%. Unlocks the Gas Turbine 3 MW.

flavor.quote: The world of the future will be an ever more demanding struggle against the limitations of our intelligence
flavor.author: Norbert Wiener

name: Battery Hall Permit
description: Fire-code sign-off for a thousand cells in one room. Unlocks the Battery Hall 2.4 MWh.

flavor.quote: One never notices what has been done; one can only see what remains to be done.
flavor.author: Marie Curie

name: Transmission Feeder Agreement
description: A private line to the transmission grid. Grid energy price -5%. Unlocks the Grid Intake 9 MW.

flavor.quote: I hear America singing, the varied carols I hear
flavor.author: Walt Whitman

name: Rapid Swap Procedures
description: GPU tray swaps timed to the minute. Bot repairs 15% faster.

flavor.quote: Everyone knows that debugging is twice as hard as writing a program in the first place.
flavor.author: Brian Kernighan
flavor.source: The Elements of Programming Style, 2nd ed., ch. 2

name: Bot Drivetrain Upgrade
description: Faster actuators and louder fans. Bot speed +10%.

flavor.quote: I wish to God these calculations had been executed by steam.
flavor.author: Charles Babbage

name: Aerial Survey Drones
description: Rotors that skip the lift entirely. Unlocks the Survey Drone (flies between floors, 0.5 tiles per tick).

flavor.quote: The universe is wider than our views of it.
flavor.author: Henry David Thoreau

name: Central Warehousing
description: Bin locations, barcodes and a stock count. Unlocks the Central Parts Warehouse.

flavor.quote: It's the equivalent of a bicycle for our minds.
flavor.author: Steve Jobs

name: Fast Charging
description: Twenty-five kilowatts per berth. Unlocks the Fast-Charge Bay.

flavor.quote: Please cut off a nanosecond and send it over to me.
flavor.author: Grace Hopper

name: Heavy Lifter Chassis
description: A reinforced bot with room for three spare parts. Unlocks the Heavy Lifter Bot (carries 3 spare parts per trip).

flavor.quote: Thinking is the hardest work there is, which is the probable reason why so few engage in it.
flavor.author: Henry Ford
flavor.source: The Forum, April 1928 (interview with Fay Leone Faurote)

name: Autonomous Maintenance Corps
description: A coordinated fleet instead of a loose group. Bot repairs 10% faster. Bot speed +5%.

flavor.quote: Clearly, we must break away from the sequential and not limit the computers.
flavor.author: Grace Hopper
flavor.source: Management and the Computer of the Future, 1962

name: Wetware Annex Programme
description: A new annex off the plant room, with a floor drain and a risk assessment. Unlocks the OC-1 Organoid Cabinet and the Nutrient Medium Plant, and lets you lay nutrient pipe like coolant.

flavor.quote: I had worked hard for nearly two years, for the sole purpose of infusing life into an inanimate body.
flavor.author: Mary Shelley

name: Sterile Protocols
description: Gowning, wash-down and a laminated chart. Unlocks the Sterile Bay.

flavor.quote: From then on, when anything went wrong with a computer, we said it had bugs in it.
flavor.author: Grace Hopper

name: Quarantine Procedure
description: Doors that interlock before you finish the sentence. Unlocks the Quarantine Lock.

flavor.quote: I think the major good idea in Unix was its clean and simple interface: open, close, read, and write.
flavor.author: Ken Thompson
flavor.source: Unix and Beyond: An Interview with Ken Thompson, 1999

name: Disposal Licence
description: A permit with a very short distribution list. Unlocks the Biomass Disposal Suite.

flavor.quote: Out, out, brief candle!
flavor.author: William Shakespeare

name: DNA Archive Licence
description: Storage that grows its own shelves. Unlocks the DNA Storage Vault: 16,000 TB per cabinet.

flavor.quote: Information is information, not matter or energy.
flavor.author: Norbert Wiener

name: Bio-Reactor Permit
description: Power from fermentation, under licence 41-C. Unlocks the Bio-Reactor BR-500: 500 kW for 14 units of nutrient medium a tick.

flavor.quote: Drive out fear, so that everyone may work effectively for the company.
flavor.author: W. Edwards Deming

name: Neural Vat Dossier
description: Forty pages, none of them dated. Unlocks the OC-4 Neural Vat: 460 PFLOPS per vat.

flavor.quote: Beware, for I am fearless and therefore powerful.
flavor.author: Mary Shelley

name: Tissue Scaffolds
description: Lattices that keep the tissue where it was put. Rack failure rate -7%.

flavor.quote: The web is more a social creation than a technical one.
flavor.author: Tim Berners-Lee

name: Asset Register
description: Everything the Authority now considers yours, indexed. Research points earned +10%.

flavor.quote: Rather little mechanism, and lots of blank sheets.
flavor.author: Alan Turing

name: Works Foreman
description: An automated build planner. Switches on the Works Foreman: once ordered, it builds racks, cooling and spare power where the capacity model says you are short, at most 1 facility per game-hour.

flavor.quote: Management has authority only as long as it performs.
flavor.author: Peter Drucker

name: Fleet Policy Update
description: A policy document the bots have, against expectations, begun to read. Bot walking and flying speed +8%. The Works Foreman places 2 facilities per game-hour instead of 1.

flavor.quote: A system must be managed. It will not manage itself.
flavor.author: W. Edwards Deming

name: Solar Charter
description: Roof and wall rights for photovoltaics. Unlocks the PV Wall Panels 150 kW: 150 kW at noon on a clear day, nothing at night.

flavor.quote: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
flavor.author: Alan Kay

name: Wind Mast Permit
description: Planning consent for a mast on an upper floor. Unlocks the Wind Mast WM-300: up to 300 kW, on the third floor or above.

flavor.quote: The nice thing about standards is that you have so many to choose from.
flavor.author: Andrew Tanenbaum

name: District Heat Agreement
description: Your waste heat is formally recognised as saleable. Unlocks the Heat Recovery Unit 400 kW: 400 kW of heat sold at $3 a kWh.

flavor.quote: The Web does not just connect machines, it connects people.
flavor.author: Tim Berners-Lee

name: Algae Cultivation Licence
description: Permission to grow algae on the building envelope. Unlocks the Algae Bioreactor Facade: 160 carbon credits a day.

flavor.quote: Once you get your courage up and believe that you can do important problems, then you can.
flavor.author: Richard Hamming

name: Canopy Array Study
description: Load calculations for a roof-mounted panel field. Unlocks the PV Roof Canopy 420 kW: 420 kW at noon on a clear day.

flavor.quote: Great cities are not like towns, only larger. They are not like suburbs, only denser.
flavor.author: Jane Jacobs
flavor.source: The Death and Life of Great American Cities, 1961, p. 30

name: Heat Link Franchise
description: An exclusive right to supply the district network. Unlocks the District Heat Link 1.6 MW: 1,600 kW of heat sold at $3 a kWh.

flavor.quote: The power of the Web is in its universality.
flavor.author: Tim Berners-Lee

name: Carbon Capture Study
description: Proof that the carbon removed was carbon that was there. Unlocks the Carbon Capture Stack: 1,100 carbon credits a day.

flavor.quote: The “control of nature” is a phrase conceived in arrogance
flavor.author: Rachel Carson

name: Green Tariff
description: Every kilowatt-hour tracked by source and priced accordingly. Grid energy price -8%.

flavor.quote: The cost of a thing is the amount of what I will call life which is required to be exchanged for it
flavor.author: Henry David Thoreau

name: Photonic Bench Study
description: An optical bench and a long qualification run. Unlocks the PH-1 Photonic Rack: 480 PFLOPS from 40 kW.

flavor.quote: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.
flavor.author: Arthur C. Clarke
flavor.source: Profiles of the Future, rev. ed., 1973

name: Cryo Chiller Study
description: A refrigeration schematic with a margin note reading "colder". Unlocks the Cryo Chiller CC-3000: 3,000 kW of heat removed at a COP of 16.

flavor.quote: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself — and you are the easiest person to fool.
flavor.author: Richard Feynman
flavor.source: Cargo Cult Science, Caltech commencement address, 1974

name: Continuity of Service Spec
description: Certifies that the process which began is the process which ends. Unlocks the Continuity Monitor: 800 kW and 400 kWh of ride-through.

flavor.quote: For a successful technology, reality must take precedence over public relations, for nature cannot be fooled.
flavor.author: Richard Feynman

name: Backup Vault Charter
description: Cold storage for everything that should not be lost, and some things that should. Unlocks the Process Backup Vault: 20,000 TB.

flavor.quote: I can visualize a time in the future when we will be to robots as dogs are to humans.
flavor.author: Claude Shannon

name: Mind Lattice Dossier
description: A specification for a rack that would prefer to be called a resident. Unlocks the ML-1 Mind Lattice Rack: 700 PFLOPS from 220 kW. Research points earned +10%, from the register of every hosted process.

flavor.quote: The stuff of the world is mind-stuff.
flavor.author: Arthur Eddington
flavor.source: The Nature of the Physical World, 1928

name: Continuity Policy
description: No process is ever finished, only archived. Rack failure rate -8%.

flavor.quote: The saddest aspect of life right now is that science gathers knowledge faster than society gathers wisdom.
flavor.author: Isaac Asimov
flavor.source: Isaac Asimov's Book of Science and Nature Quotations, 1988

name: Culture Media Procurement
description: A standing order for broth, agar and a lockable fridge. Rack failure rate -3%. Required before the Wetware Annex.

flavor.quote: Our life is frittered away by detail.
flavor.author: Henry David Thoreau

name: Fleet Command Desk
description: A rota, a radio and a whiteboard for the bots. Unlocks the Fleet Coordinator Bot: carries 5 spare parts a trip and works a repair in 14 ticks.

flavor.quote: It is better to pick the wrong priority than none at all.
flavor.author: Peter Drucker

name: Grid Autonomy Charter
description: Permission to disagree with the utility in writing. Unlocks the Grid Intake 20 MW.

flavor.quote: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately
flavor.author: Henry David Thoreau

name: Immersion Vault Study
description: A sealed hall, a very large tank and an insurer who asked to be removed from the thread. Unlocks the IM-3 Vault Immersion Tank: 800 PFLOPS at 380 kW.

flavor.quote: Software gets slower faster than hardware gets faster.
flavor.author: Niklaus Wirth
flavor.source: A Plea for Lean Software, Computer, February 1995

name: Authority Charter
description: The Compute Authority formally recognises research as an activity of the tower. Research points earned +20%.

flavor.quote: The law’s delay, the insolence of office
flavor.author: William Shakespeare

name: Organoid Vat Programme
description: Cabinets scaled up to vats, with the same drain. Unlocks the OC-2 Organoid Vat Bank: 300 PFLOPS from 45 kW.

flavor.quote: Look on my works ye Mighty, and despair!
flavor.author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

name: Synaptic Mesh
description: A grid of fine wire through the tissue, so that failures are noticed earlier than they happen. Rack failure rate -10%.

flavor.quote: I am large, I contain multitudes.
flavor.author: Walt Whitman
flavor.source: Song of Myself, Leaves of Grass
